purpose: Broader research after a narrow parameter sweep; explicitly not a claim that v1 is perfectly calibrated.
data: Official public API raw responses plus the checksum-pinned 2016/17-2025/26 gameweek archive.
official_limits: Verify history_past grain, current-player survivor coverage, and whether a tested season query actually changes the season. Do not relabel aggregate totals as gameweek history.
minutes_hypothesis: Learn disjoint no-appearance/1-59/>=60-minute states from prior seasons instead of imposing fixed conditional-start/cameo probabilities.
rolling_origin: For each test year 2017/18-2025/26, select on the immediately previous year using only years before that year; refit through the previous year. First fold uses declared window6/pseudocount50 defaults.
minutes_selection_metric: Multiclass log loss on a fixed lag-defined active-candidate pool. Also report all previously observed players, appearance/P60 Brier scores and minute errors.
historical_pool: Same single-fixture targets and conservative kickoff cutoff as the original backtest. No target outcomes choose eligibility. First observed rows are excluded because historical registration vintages are unavailable.
points_test: Plug the independently learned minute states into the unchanged v1 component formula on 2023/24-2025/26; compare v1 and the existing rolling-points benchmark.
points_recalibration: One fixed ridge regression: points ~ slope*xP + position intercept*P(appear), with ridge1000 and identity prior. Fit only earlier-season chronological predictions; no target-season outcomes. No additional parameter search.
current_seven: Fit through2025/26; reuse exact pre-deadline 2026/27 GW1-7 snapshots. Freeze the original candidate pool and actual owned15. Evaluate new/thin-prior cohorts separately. No current results select or tune parameters.
honesty: All these old seasons/current seven outcomes have now been inspected. Chronological fitting prevents feature/target leakage but does not make this a fresh untouched external test. GW8 onward remains prospective evidence.
promotion: Research results only. Do not automatically replace the live numerical model or claim optimal calibration. Report mixed metrics, uncertainty, scoring-era limits and full-policy gaps.

items: Position-constant minute probabilities fitted only on earlier active-candidate observations
